question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seated around a round table facing the center. Only two people sit between G and C, when counted from the left of C. F sits third to the left of E. B sits to the immediate right of E. B sits second to the left of G. D is an immediate neighbor of F. How many people sit between A and C, when counted from the right of C?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seated around a round table facing the center.

Only two people sit between G and C, when counted from the left of C.

B sits second to the left of G.

B sits to the immediate right of E.

F sits third to the left of E.

D is an immediate neighbor of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c50d5cdf038e86780fb298a629100b813b71f8376d5b06b595dc38f3552bfd8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef3121882e22ad2fe14c47c52834c796d781fec5b0d716a7238b6fc0d725384e.png] 

Thus, 2 people sit between A and C, when counted from the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
